question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: A practitioner may attain great accomplishment in enjoyment and liberation.
Such accomplishment results in becoming dear to the yoginīs.
inference: Great accomplishment in enjoyment and liberation makes one dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: One may attain great accomplishment in both enjoyment and liberation and become dear to the yoginīs.
